candidates.change_summary: Change the required deposit from 1 ether to 2 ether, so callers must send 2 ether and the stored guess occurs only when msg.value == 2 ether.
Remove the check that the caller has no existing guess, allowing callers to overwrite an existing stored guess and block number.
Set the stored block to the current block number instead of block.number + 1, changing which block's hash will be used later.
Insert an extra assignment that immediately clears the guess after setting it, so no guess persists after lockInGuess returns.
Assign the guess to hash XORed with a constant, altering the stored guess value observed later.
Replace the conditional check from 'block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block' to '>=' so settle can run in the same block as the locked guess block, changing when funds/state can be cleared.
Move the state reset 'guesses[msg.sender].block = 0;' to after the transfer, so the mapping isn't cleared before a successful payout (changes state visible if transfer reverts or effects differ).
Change the comparison to check guesses[msg.sender].guess != answer instead of equality, so transfer occurs for non-matching guesses, altering post-settle state and balances.
Insert an extra unconditional reset clearing both fields of the guess struct before computing answer, which changes the state visible after settle.
Replace retrieval of blockhash to use the previous block (guesses[msg.sender].block - 1), changing which blockhash is compared and thus observable outcomes.
